name: 使用 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 的安全风险检测 (6NL)
name_en: Security Risk Detection with SAP Risk and Assurance Management (6NL)
description_en_html:
Overview

SAP Risk and Assurance Management can be integrated with an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system. With SAP Risk and Assurance Management security controls, SAP establishes effective means to analyze and detect (cyber) security anomalies in your connected SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system.

Technical checks deployed with SAP S/4HANA include checks to:

  • Detect if User ID SAPSTAR does not meet the rules

  • Detect if User ID DDIC does not meet the rules

  • Detect if User ID SAPCPIC does not meet the rules

  • Detect if User ID TSMADM does not meet the rules

  • Detect if there is long-term validity for temporary users

  • Detect if there are any roles that should not be but assigned for longer than X days

  • Detect if any active Dialog user has SAP_ALL or SAP_NEW profile assigned

  • Detect if there are any Dormant IDs to be locked

  • Detect if there are any Unused IDs to be locked

  • Detect if there are any Expired accounts to be locked

  • Detect if there are any Expired accounts to be deleted

  • Detect if there are any Expired Users with Valid Roles

Key Process Flow

  • Create a connection from SAP Risk and Assurance Management to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system as outlined in the SAP Risk and Assurance Management administration guide in the "Connectivity for Automated Procedures" section
  • Maintain the parameters of the automated procedure as outlined in the SAP Risk and Assurance Management user help for automated procedures and the respective information from the business content section
  • Activate the procedure and maintain further custom parameters as necessary before executing the procedure via control and work package setup in SAP Risk and Assurance Management

Business Benefits

  • Proactively safeguard the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system against (cyber) security weaknesses and attacks from a central entry point
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP Risk and Assurance Management 可与 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统集成。通过 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 安全控制，SAP 建立了有效的方法来分析和检测连接的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统中的（网络）安全异常。

使用 SAP S/4HANA 部署的技术检查包括以下检查：

  • 检测用户标识 SAPSTAR 是否不符合规则

  • 检测用户标识 DDIC 是否不符合规则

  • 检测用户标识 SAPCPIC 是否不符合规则

  • 检测用户标识 TSMADM 是否不符合规则

  • 检测临时用户是否存在长期有效期

  • 检测是否有任何不应分配但分配时间超过 X 天的角色

  • 检测是否有任何活动对话用户已分配 SAP_ALL 或 SAP_NEW 参数文件

  • 检测是否存在任何要锁定的休眠标识

  • 检测是否有任何未使用的标识要锁定。

  • 检测是否有任何过期帐户要锁定。

  • 检测是否存在任何要删除的过期帐户。

  • 检测是否存在任何具有有效角色的过期用户。

关键流程流

  • 创建从 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统的连接，如 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 管理指南的“自动化程序的连接”部分所述
  • 维护自动化过程的参数，如 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 用户帮助中所述，以获取自动化过程和业务内容部分中的相应信息
  • 通过 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 中的控制和工作包设置执行过程之前，请激活过程并根据需要维护更多自定义参数

业务优势

  • 从中央入口点主动保护 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统免受（网络）安全漏洞和攻击
